capabilities: Collect unchecked tasks from recent daily notes
Collect open questions by question mark, question tag or question callout
Link each item back to its source note, heading or block ID
Show repeated tasks once and skip items an earlier rollup carried
Write a dated review note to a chosen folder, with an optional weekly reminder
disambiguation: Not a tool that merges or edits daily notes; it only reads them and writes a separate review note.
extras: Runs entirely locally with no network requests. Installation instructions are manual only (copy files into the plugins folder).
problem: Unfinished tasks and open questions written in daily notes sink under the next day's note and are never revisited.

relations.evidence: It pairs well with plugins that put things into daily notes, such as Smart Daily Capture and Quick Timestamp
It pairs well with plugins that put things into daily notes, such as Smart Daily Capture and Quick Timestamp
the folder, date format and template come from Periodic Notes or the core Daily notes plugin

summary: Reads recent daily notes and gathers unchecked tasks and open questions into one review note, each linked back to its source line.
